name: AWS
description: Amazon Web Services operates data centers to rent out computing power, storage, and/or software. The operator distinguishes itself through the broad service portfolio of platform services, ranging from serverless functions to hardware accelerators.

name: Megaport
description: Megaport is a network service provider offering on-demand layer two connectivity between data centers, cloud providers, and managed networks worldwide. Through a centralized portal or API, users can provision point-to-point connections and adjust bandwidth in real time, bypassing traditional telecom infrastructure.
